messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] GPU pool saturation detected — region: us-west-2, pool: gpu-p-xlarge. queue_length=1204, p95_latency=1.9s. Severity: P1. Pager: @kate (ops-oncall)
kate (ops-oncall): I'm on it. pulling up autoscaler + pool metrics now. any immediate customer impact?
miguel (eng-runtime): autoscaler logs show repeated failures to scale up: provider API returning 403 QuotaExceeded. No new instances launching since 3255552000.
anya (infra-lead): confirmed with cloud support — vCPU quota in us-west-2 exhausted for our account. Raised escalation ticket, looking like 12–30m ETA for approval unless we do a manual change.
dev (sre-rotations): queue is growing. Can we route lower-priority tenants to fallback pool (gpu-fallback-spot) temporarily? That should shave off a chunk of the queue.
kate (ops-oncall): applying fallback routing now for non-SLA tenants. running: 
```bash
POST /v1/routing/policy/apply -d '{"route":"fallback","filter":"tier!=enterprise"}'
```
miguel (eng-runtime): also recommending we enable model-variant downgrade for heavy routes (fp16-quant) to reduce memory pressure. canary -> 5% to start.
anya (infra-lead): I can also relax our per-host packing limits to increase density by ~10% for the next 30m if SRE agrees.
dev (sre-rotations): do that and we'll monitor eviction rates. if OOMs spike we rollback.
liam (customer-success): heads-up: I'll post a short customer advisory: "We are experiencing degraded inference latency in US-West; mitigations in progress. We'll update in 15m."
kate (ops-oncall): fallback routing confirmed applied. queue dropped to ~600 in 6m. p95 still elevated for some routes.
miguel (eng-runtime): logs snippet: 
```
[3255553300] autoscaler ERROR: launch failed: 403 QuotaExceeded: vCPU quota exceeded in us-west-2
```
dev (sre-rotations): can we shift some canaries and low-risk jobs to eu-west temporarily to relieve US?
anya (infra-lead): yes, I'll open cross-region routing for a subset of tenants. pushing cloud ticket for quota increase (escalation).
incident-bot: Bridgecall scheduled in 3m: zoom.us/j/xxxxx (ops bridge).
kate (ops-oncall): handoff note: I need to step away in ~8m. leaving bridge & thread notes. key mitigations in progress: fallback routing, model downgrade canary, density increase.
ravi (sre-night): taking handoff — ravi here. will monitor queue and coordinate with infra if quota approval is slower than ETA. summary noted.
miguel (eng-runtime): short list of post-incident action candidates: 1) proactive region quota monitor + alerting; 2) autoscaler fallback path to spot/fallback pools by default; 3) per-tenant deprioritization config and automated reroute policy; 4) runbook update for cloud quota escalations.
liam (customer-success): CS team posted impacted tenants to #ops-customer-alerts and started outreach for top 5 customers.
kate (ops-oncall): before I go: please persist autoscaler logs, snapshot queue, and run `scripts/eviction_scrub.sh` at T+30 if queue not under 100. I pushed a short runbook note to the incident doc.
ravi (sre-night): acknowledged. plan: run eviction scrub at 3255556120 (T+30m), verify queue <100 and p95 within SLO, then close bridge. ping me here for status updates.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Severity downgraded to P2 — mitigations showing effect; monitoring continuing.
